title: HarnessMDP: Learning to Control LLM Agent Harnesses with Offline Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2607.05458v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The execution harness is a critical component of LLM agents, shaping how the agent interacts with its environment and organizes multi-step execution. Prior work has shown that improving tools, workflows, and other harness components can substantially improve agent performance. This suggests that the harness can be treated as a learnable control layer that adapts execution decisions from experience, rather than as a predetermined execution configuration. In this work, we introduce HarnessMDP, a learning-based framework that makes harness control itself learnable. HarnessMDP formulates agent execution as a finite-horizon Markov decision process, where the harness learns to select structural execution actions from the evolving agent state. The harness policy is learned offline from collected trajectories using task performance and deployed online to adaptively control new executions. Extensive experiments on coding tasks, tau-benc

translated_title: HarnessMDP：利用离线强化学习学习控制大语言模型智能体执行框架
translated_abstract: 执行框架是大语言模型智能体的关键组成部分，它决定了智能体如何与环境交互以及如何组织多步骤执行。先前的工作表明，改进工具、工作流和其他框架组件可以显著提升智能体性能。这表明执行框架可以被看作一个可学习的控制层，能够根据经验自适应地调整执行决策，而不是一个预先确定的执行配置。在本工作中，我们提出了HarnessMDP，一个使框架控制本身可学习的基于学习的框架。HarnessMDP将智能体执行建模为一个有限时域的马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），其中框架学习根据不断演变的智能体状态选择结构性执行动作。框架策略从收集的轨迹中基于任务性能进行离线学习，并在线部署以自适应地控制新的执行。在编码任务、tau-bench等基准上的大量实验……
tldr: 提出HarnessMDP框架，将LLM智能体执行框架的控制建模为有限时域马尔可夫决策过程，通过离线强化学习从任务轨迹中学习框架策略，使框架能够根据演变的智能体状态自适应地选择结构性执行动作。
en_tdlr: HarnessMDP formulates LLM agent harness control as a finite-horizon Markov decision process and learns the harness policy via offline reinforcement learning from collected trajectories, enabling adaptive selection of structural execution actions based on the evolving agent state.
